typography.headingCharacter: A geometric sans set in semibold (600) and always uppercase, large and blocky (64-78px display sizes) with tight leading around 1.2x cap height.
typography.bodyCharacter: Regular weight (400), sentence case, ~1.5x leading at 16-20px. A separate monospace face carries small uppercase eyebrow labels like "[01] COMPANY" with heavy tracking (~5px).

composition.structure: A single full-bleed photograph fills the top of the frame edge to edge, cut off abruptly at a hard horizontal line into a plain empty colour block beneath it; no columns, grid or text are visible yet.

spacing.rhythm: One large uninterrupted image block followed by one large uninterrupted empty block — the only visible rhythm is that single big break, not a repeating scale.

surfaceTreatment.finish: Plain flat cream fill below the photo; the photograph itself carries a faint dark gradient/vignette toward its lower edge, otherwise no texture or layering is visible.

imagery.treatment: A single full-bleed aerial/drone photograph of a construction site in warm, low, golden-hour light, with a subtle dark gradient overlay at the bottom edge presumably for text legibility of content not yet visible.

motion.character: Script-driven scroll motion dominates: 352 elements travel at rates other than the scroll itself (parallax/pinning), 26 fade up from invisible, 3 scale. Two linear infinite marquees (70s and 35s) run with no input. Hover is inert.
motion.choreography: Reveals fire at several different scroll depths rather than one group, so sections arrive in sequence as they are reached; a sticky/resizing header persists throughout, and the marquee and testimonial tracks loop continuously and independently underneath the scroll-triggered reveals.

philosophy.text: This capture reads as the very top of a page where a single dramatic, wide-format photograph is left to carry the entire opening statement, with no headline, navigation or UI chrome yet competing for attention. The abrupt cut to a flat, empty cream field beneath it signals restraint: whatever content follows is being deliberately withheld from this frame, letting the image's own scale and light do the persuasive work before any typographic or systemic design decisions become visible. It trades immediate information density for a slower, image-first reveal.

build.techniques: Full-bleed responsive hero image (object-fit: cover) with a bottom gradient overlay for contrast; nothing else in this capture calls for a distinctive stack.
